findings.title: The named addressee becomes the focus of pledged service and help
findings.claim: The addressee named and praised earlier becomes the sole object of the two focus acts: service and help are spoken as a binding, shared orientation toward that addressee.
findings.mechanism: The earlier naming supplies the referent, while the same fronted second-person object is repeated before both first-person plural verbs; the return from praise to parallel direct address turns recognition into pledged practice.
findings.reader_payoff: The movement from praise to direct commitment becomes perceptible, and the two clauses read as related acts rather than separate statements.
findings.containment: The relation deepens the ordinary meanings of worship and seeking help; it does not replace either verb with a single abstract idea or claim that the two acts are identical.

epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run finding supplies the focus branches and their relation; the pericope's prior address and the exact repeated focus objects provide the carrier and trigger contact.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Merkezî dinsel kullanım, Tanrı'ya yönelen tapınma ve kendini bu yönelişe vermedir.
branch_activations.carrier: The ongoing first-person plural act of worshipful service in نَعْبُدُ.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The addressee has already been named and praised in the opening pericope, and the fronted object is renewed before the service verb.
branch_activations.activation: The prior named referent and the repeated fronted object make the service branch contact the same addressee as an already established relationship.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Worship becomes the spoken form of a binding service orientation toward the known addressee.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not erase the ordinary worshipful action or turn the claim into a general theory of all service.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Yapıya bağlı kullanımlarda kişi başkasından yardım ister veya taraflar birbirlerine yardım ederek birlikte hareket eder.
branch_activations.carrier: The ongoing first-person plural request for help in نَسْتَعِينُ.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The previously addressed and praised figure is placed again before the aid-seeking verb in a parallel clause.
branch_activations.activation: The same fronted addressee that receives service also receives the request for support, binding the two acts to one relational center.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Seeking help becomes the companion expression of the pledged service orientation.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that service is passive or that help cancels the community's own action.

findings.title: Dependence is held together by requested support
findings.claim: The service relation can be heard as dependence that receives support: the community remains an active servant while asking the same addressee to make that service possible.
findings.mechanism: The focus service carrier contacts the owned, subjected, and worshipful facets supplied under ع ب د, while the following help carrier supplies the relation's backing; the prior ownership and submission context gives the dependence an independent frame.
findings.reader_payoff: The sequence holds humility and agency together: the speakers act, and they ask for the support by which the action can continue.
findings.containment: The ownership and subjection facets are contextual pressure around the focus verb, not a claim that the local Form I verb literally states legal enslavement or coercive human ownership.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run finding is trusted and focus-anchored, while the owned and subjected facets are a contextual resonance qualified by the local worshipful form.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi özgürün karşıtı olarak bir başkasının mülkiyetinde bulunur.
branch_activations.carrier: The first-person plural service action in نَعْبُدُ.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The prior pericope supplies ownership and submission context, and the following clause asks the same addressee for help.
branch_activations.activation: The ownership frame meets the service carrier at the point where help is requested, making dependence a supported relation rather than a bare status.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The service claim includes the posture of one who depends on the addressee while continuing to act.
branch_activations.boundary: The contextual facet does not assert the legal status of the speakers or replace worship with slavery.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Merkezî dinsel kullanım, Tanrı'ya yönelen tapınma ve kendini bu yönelişe vermedir.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The adjacent first-person plural request for help from the same fronted addressee.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Worship is active service sustained by dependence on the addressed helper.
branch_activations.boundary: The service remains an action of the speakers; the reading does not make them inert recipients.

findings.title: Service as the work that makes a road passable
findings.claim: In the approach to the straight-road request, worshipful service can also be seen as repeated work that presses a course flat and makes it passable.
findings.mechanism: The focus service word carries the supplied road-smoothing facet; the next pericope supplies the road as an independent object, and the connection record explicitly joins devotion to the straight route.
findings.reader_payoff: The request for guidance arrives after a form of path-making has already become visible, so service acquires a bodily and practical dimension.
findings.containment: The road image extends the ordinary worshipful service; it does not substitute physical roadwork for devotion or claim that every available ع ب د branch is active.

epistemic.reason: A trusted publication supplies the focus branch and legacy retrospective and wide-walk records repeat the same anchored road contact; the context return is explicit, but the image remains a contextual resonance.

epistemic.reason: The trusted publication anchors the aid balance facet and the wide-context record supplies the upright and evenness contacts; the resulting internal stabilization remains qualified contextual evidence.

findings.containment: The emotional discipline supports the ordinary worshipful service and does not claim that the focus word names anger or that the later groups are reduced to psychology.

findings.containment: These path and alignment facets extend the worshipful service reading without making the focus a literal road instruction or selecting this image over the ordinary act.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk nomination supplies exact branch identities and the 1:6 return, but its legacy provenance and cross-ayah inference require qualification.

findings.containment: The supported-walking image adds a mode of aid while preserving the ordinary request for help; it does not assert physical incapacity or eliminate collective agency.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk record names all four branches and their order, while the packet's path connection supplies a wider trigger; the legacy source makes the synthesis qualified.

findings.claim: The focus places service and requested support before the explicit request for the straight road, so the work of making a way passable appears before asking where to go.

findings.reader_payoff: The transition into the next ayah becomes an ordered movement from making movement possible to asking for direction.
findings.containment: The sequence adds temporal and practical structure to the ordinary clauses; it does not claim that service earns guidance or that one clause replaces the other.

findings.title: Two later contacts for the service word
findings.claim: The focus service word remains open to two distinct later contacts: it can meet the passable road in 1:6 and the wounded pride exposed by the contrary groups in 1:7.
findings.mechanism: The road trigger activates B005 through the following route, while the anger trigger activates B008 through the later opposition; each returns to the same exact focus carrier by a different mechanism.
findings.reader_payoff: The service act gains both a course-making image and an inward disciplinary pressure without forcing them into one master picture.
findings.containment: These are two coexisting contextual resonances around the ordinary worshipful service; the evidence does not select one as the hidden meaning or assert that the two images are identical.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective reader record explicitly preserves both focus branches and their separate later returns; its provenance is legacy_unbound.

findings.title: Requested aid gives service capacity
findings.claim: The two parallel clauses portray service and aid as one dependent relation in which requested backing gives the community capacity to sustain its service.
findings.mechanism: The same fronted object is repeated before both focus verbs, the actor remains first-person plural, and the clause order places aid immediately after service; together these cues let support explain how the service continues.
findings.reader_payoff: The second clause becomes an answer to the pressure of the first: the community asks for the capacity required by the service it has just professed.
findings.containment: The relation preserves both directions in the text: service is stated before aid is requested, while the evidence does not settle a single exclusive causal arrow or make help unrelated to action.

epistemic.reason: The wide-context reader record supplies the exact parallel structure and the service-capacity inference; its reader provenance is legacy_unbound.

friction_notes: All 26 supplied candidates were reviewed exactly once. The seven HFT records were visible under the packet policy, but each supplied only an unanchored summary with empty anchor evidence; no exact context ayah, word index, root, attributed role, or focus-return coordinate was available, so those records were rejected at the activation edge rather than treated as absent.

The packet has no selected_context_units. Pericope ayah refs and exact connection target evidence were retained only as contextual triggers where the supplied branch record and support text named the matching relation; no missing morphology was invented for connection targets.

The full branch registry was inspected for uncandidate activations. Unlinked branches remain availability-only because the packet supplies no independent trigger and changed reading that returns through the focus; the retained findings preserve the qualified split-root and contextual contacts that do pass that test.
